description: Add comprehensive Pull Request formatting guidelines to the agent documentation to standardize contribution practices. The guidelines should establish clear conventions for PR titles using Conventional Commits format and provide a structured template for PR descriptions. This will improve consistency and reviewability for all agent-related contributions.
functional_requirements: Add a new section to the agent documentation covering PR formatting standards
Define Conventional Commits format for PR titles with specific rules, examples, and common commit types
Include suggested scopes tailored to the agent codebase (general and documentation-specific)
Provide a PR description checklist covering 'What', 'Why', 'Changes', and 'Testing' sections
Establish a specific convention for identifying Cursor-authored PRs
